topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and outlines how the initiation and resolution of inflammation will be explored.

topics.label: Innate Immune Recognition and Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the innate immune system detects microbes and cellular damage using PAMPs, DAMPs, and various pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cascades, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Systemic Consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how activated sentinel cells drive immune cell extravasation, lymphatic drainage, and severe systemic reactions like septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms that shut down inflammation, repair damaged tissue, and form granulomas when pathogens persist.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic marks the end of the lecture and previews the subsequent lecture on the complement system.
